info.title: API.SH: GovDeals
info.description: The GovDeals API from API.SH: public GovDeals data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
GovDeals categories. By default the category tree with live listing counts (top-level groups with their categories and sub-categories, as the site's menu shows them); `flat=true` gives the alphabetical list of every category with id, parent, level, count and slug. Use the ids as `category` in /govdeals/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/govdeals-categories

parameters.name: flat
parameters.description: true: the alphabetical flat list instead of the tree.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One GovDeals listing: title, full description, make, model, year, VIN or serial, condition, quantity, odometer or hours, title status, every attribute the seller filled in, category path, auction type and dates, lot and sale event, the seller (agency name, website and the agency's listed contact for the lot: name, e-mail, phone), item location with coordinates, shipping, inspection, payment and removal instructions, special terms, all photos, video, attachments, amendments and the public questions and answers. Pass the two numbers from the listing link /asset/<asset_id>/<account_id>, or the link as `url`. Unknown listings answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/govdeals-listing

parameters.name: asset_id
parameters.description: First number in the listing link.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Second number in the listing link (the seller account).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Or the listing link, e.g. https://www.govdeals.com/asset/17/30965.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Government and public-sector surplus auctions on GovDeals: vehicles, heavy equipment, real estate, electronics and everything else agencies sell. Each item has title, make, model, year, category, current bid, bid increment, buy-now price, reserve flags, auction type, start and end time, lot and sale event, seller (agency) and location, photo and link. Filter by keyword, category, state or province, condition, seller type, country, seller, sale event, make, model, year, auction type, buy-now and reserve; `sold=true` searches closed auctions with their final bids. `facets=true` adds the site's filter counts (category tree, states, conditions, sellers, makes, models...), each with a `filter` value you can pass back as `filter`. `total` is the number of matches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/govdeals-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id from /govdeals/v1/categories (e.g. 94C trucks, 644 bucket trucks) or a top-level group (t6 transportation).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state or Canadian province: two-letter code or name.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Seller account id (the second number in a listing link /asset/<asset_id>/<account_id>).

parameters.name: auction_type
parameters.description: 3 auction, 4 buy now / fixed price, 5 make an offer.

parameters.name: buy_now
parameters.description: true: only items with a buy-now price.

parameters.name: reserve
parameters.description: met (no reserve or reserve met) or not_met.

parameters.name: sold
parameters.description: true: closed auctions with their final bids.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet's `filter` value from a facets=true answer; repeat for several.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), current_bid, closing, newest or lot_number.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: GovDeals sellers near a ZIP code
get.description:
GovDeals sellers (agencies and organisations) with listings near a US ZIP code: name, seller id, address, coordinates, distance in miles, number of open listings and whether they have new listings. Pass a `seller_id` to /govdeals/v1/search to list a seller's items.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/govdeals-sellers

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
